overview: The Commission for Persons with Disabilities voted to submit a letter of support for an accessible trails feasibility study at Middlesex Fells and reviewed proposed revisions to modernize the commission's city ordinance. Commissioners also received updates on a state planning grant and discussed preparations for the upcoming May Disability Fair.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission moved and approved the meeting minutes from December 2025.

items.title: Municipal Grant and Accessible Parking Fines Update
items.summary: Frances Nwajei announced that Medford was officially awarded a state planning grant to work with the Institute for Human Centered Design on a self-evaluation and transition plan, and provided an update on adopting Massachusetts General Law Chapter 40, Section 22G to direct accessible parking violation fines to the commission.

items.title: Friends of the Fells Accessible Trails Project
items.summary: Maddie Morgan presented a grant proposal for a feasibility study to construct accessible trails in the Middlesex Fells Reservation, and the commission voted to issue a formal letter of support.

items.title: Draft Ordinance Revisions
items.summary: The commission reviewed proposed language updates to modernize its municipal ordinance, debated membership criteria and staggered terms, and voted to table the item pending legal clarification from the Massachusetts Office on Disability.

items.title: Disability Fair and City Event Announcements
items.summary: Members discussed logistics, entertainment, and vendor outreach for the Disability Fair scheduled for May 9, and Nwajei announced upcoming municipal celebrations for Black History Month and Lunar New Year.

items.title: Saltonstall Building Parking and Snow Accumulation
items.summary: Commissioners discussed jurisdiction and advocacy options regarding accessible parking concerns raised by a resident at the Saltonstall building, and shared notes on winter snow accumulation obstructing accessible spaces.
